channels.name: Avalon-ST
channels.purpose: Streaming data with backpressure and optional packets.

channels.name: Conduit
channels.purpose: Arbitrary signals to the top level / pins.

global_signals.name: Clock
global_signals.purpose: Avalon Clock interface times all transfers.

global_signals.name: Reset
global_signals.purpose: Avalon Reset interface resets the interfaces.

handshake_pairs.name: waitrequest
handshake_pairs.rule: Wait-state insertion: host holds command stable until waitrequest deasserts.

handshake_pairs.name: readdatavalid
handshake_pairs.rule: Qualifies pipelined readdata; decouples address and data phases.

handshake_pairs.name: valid/ready
handshake_pairs.rule: Avalon-ST transfer honored per readyLatency; ready provides backpressure.

handshake_pairs.name: startofpacket/endofpacket
handshake_pairs.rule: Packet framing; empty marks unused symbols in the final beat.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All Avalon transfers are synchronous to the interface's Avalon Clock and respect its Avalon Reset. Avalon-MM command acceptance depends on waitrequest; read data depends on readLatency (fixed) or readdatavalid (variable). Avalon-ST beats depend on valid/ready per readyLatency. Cross-domain connections depend on Platform-Designer clock-crossing bridges.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Avalon-MM readdata requires an accepted read (waitrequest low) and the latency model; Avalon-ST data transfer requires both valid and ready honored per readyLatency. Multi-host agents depend on the generated round-robin arbiter.

ordering_rules.mm_pipelined_reads: Pipelined Avalon-MM read responses return in request order; readdatavalid marks each response.
ordering_rules.st_beat_order: Avalon-ST beats are delivered in order; startofpacket/endofpacket bracket each packet.
ordering_rules.arbitration: Round-robin arbitration orders contending hosts on a shared agent fairly.

logical_signaling_levels.name: MM command accepted
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: read or write asserted on a cycle waitrequest is low.

logical_signaling_levels.name: MM wait-state
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: waitrequest asserted; host holds command stable.

logical_signaling_levels.name: MM pipelined read data
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: readdatavalid asserted with a readdata word.

logical_signaling_levels.name: ST beat
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: valid/ready honored per readyLatency; a data beat moves.
